title: There is a 15.4% performance regression in ycsb after PR#18248
description:
Bug Report
What version of TiKV are you using?

71aecc2
What operating system and CPU are you using?

K8S, x86
Steps to reproduce

    Deploy a cluster with 3 TiDB and 3 Tikv.
    Run benchmark ycsb (workloada).

What did you expect?

No performance regression.
What did happened?

Duration regression in benchmark ycsb (workloada) compared to baseline 169.00 after #18248.
